sources.full: Icewind Dale: Rime of the Lamberto

trait.name: Snow Camouflage
entries: The hunter has Advantage on Dexterity (Stealth) checks made to hide in snowy terrain.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The hunter makes two attacks, using Longbow or Shortsword in any combination.

action.name: Longbow
entries: {@atkr r} {@hit +5}, range 150/600 ft. {@h}7 ({@damage 1d8 + 3}) Piercing damage.

action.name: Shortsword
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit +5}, reach 5 ft. {@h}6 ({@damage 1d6 + 3}) Piercing damage.

Tribal warriors live beyond civilization, most often subsisting on fishing and hunting. Each tribe acts in accordance with the wishes of its chief, who is the greatest or oldest warrior of the tribe or a tribe member blessed by the gods.

reaction.name: Spear the Helpless (2/Day)
entries: {@actTrigger} A creature within 60 feet of the hunter gains the {@condition Restrained} condition. {@actResponse} The hunter makes a ranged attack against that creature.

trait.name: Formation Tactics
entries: The soldier has Advantage on saving throws against the {@condition Charmed}, {@condition Frightened}, {@condition Grappled}, and {@condition Restrained} conditions while it is within 5 feet of at least one ally.

action.name: Spear
entries: {@atkr m,r} {@hit +3}, reach 5 ft. or range 20/60 ft. {@h}5 ({@damage 1d6 + 2}) Piercing damage, or 6 ({@damage 1d8 + 2}) Slashing damage if used with two hands.
Soldiers are found in many of Ravnica's guilds. The soldier stat block represents a typical member of the rank and file, though weaponry and armor can vary.

reaction.name: Backstab
entries: {@actTrigger} A creature provokes an Opportunity Attack from the soldier. {@actResponse} The soldier gives the target the {@condition Prone} condition before making a melee Spear attack against it.

trait.name: Conditioned Immunity
entries: Depending on the state of the Rune Altar, some of the Shadow's abilities are disabled:
First rune: Bludgeoning, Piercing, and Slashing immunity
Fifth rune: {@condition Charmed|XPHB}, {@condition Exhaustion|XPHB}, {@condition Frightened|XPHB}, {@condition Paralyzed|XPHB}, {@condition Petrified|XPHB}, {@condition Poisoned|XPHB}
Sixth rune: Magic Resistance

trait.name: Berserk
entries: Whenever the shadow starts its turn with 60 Hit Points or fewer, roll a {@dice d6}. On a 6, the shadow goes berserk. On each of its turns while berserk, the shadow attacks the nearest creature it can see. If no creature is near enough to move to and attack, the shadow attacks an object, with preference for an object smaller than itself. Once the shadow goes berserk, it continues to do so until it is destroyed or regains all its Hit Points.

trait.name: Immutable Form
entries: The shadow is immune to any spell or effect that would alter its form.

trait.name: Magic Resistance
entries: The shadow has Advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

trait.name: Magic Weapons
entries: The shadow's weapon attacks are magical.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The shadow makes two Slam attacks.

action.name: Slam
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 7}, reach 5 ft. {@h}15 ({@damage 2d10 + 4}) Bludgeoning damage. If the target is a creature, {@actSave con} {@dc 15}, the target. {@actSaveFail} The target's Hit Point maximum decreases by an amount equal to the damage taken. The target dies if this reduces its Hit Point maximum to 0. The reduction lasts until removed by the {@spell greater restoration|xphb} spell or other magic.

action.name: Haste {@recharge 5}
entries: Until the end of its next turn, the shadow magically gains a +2 bonus to its AC, has Advantage on Dexterity saving throws, and can use its Slam attack as a Bonus Action.

trait.name: Frost Rune
entries: Hjoölvir has a frost rune inscribed on a chunk of ice or another object in her possession. While holding or wearing that object, she can use her Ice Wolves action and Ice Armor reaction.

The object has AC 16, 40 Hit Points, and immunity to Necrotic, Poison, and Psychic damage. It regains all its Hit Points at the end of each of Hjoölvir's turns, but it turns to dust if reduced to 0 Hit Points or when Hjoölvir dies. If the rune is destroyed, Hjoölvir can inscribe a new one on an object in her possession when she finishes a Short Rest or Long Rest.

trait.name: Legendary Resistance (3/Day)
entries: If Hjoölvir fails a saving throw, she can choose to succeed instead.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: Hjoölvir makes three attacks, using Greataxe or Freezing Ray in any combination.

action.name: Greataxe
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 12}, reach 10 ft. {@h}22 ({@damage 3d10 + 6}) Slashing damage plus 4 ({@damage 1d8}) Cold damage.

action.name: Freezing Ray
entries: {@atkr r} {@hit 10}, range 120 ft. {@h}17 ({@damage 3d8 + 4}) Cold damage, and the target makes a {@dc 18} Constitution saving throw. {@actSaveFail} The target has the {@condition Restrained} condition until the end of its next turn. {@actSaveSuccess} The target's Speed decreases by 10 feet until the end of its next turn.

action.name: Ice Wolves (Requires Frost Rune)
entries: Hjoölvir magically summons two wolves made of ice in unoccupied spaces she can see within 30 feet of herself. Any Ice Wolves she summoned previously disappear immediately. Each wolf has the same statistics as a {@creature winter wolf|xmm}, but it gains a +3 bonus to its attack and damage rolls while within 30 feet of Hjoölvir. The wolves take their turn immediately after Hjoölvir in the initiative order and obey her commands. The wolves disappear after 1 minute, when Hjoölvir dies, or when she uses this action again.

reaction.name: Ice Armor (Requires Frost Rune)
entries: {@actTrigger} A creature Hjoölvir can see makes an attack roll against her. {@actResponse} Hjoölvir forms a coat of ice around herself, gaining a +6 bonus to her AC against that attack, possibly causing it to miss. After the attack hits or misses, the ice shatters, and each creature in a 5-foot Emanation originating from Hjoölvir must succeed on a {@dc 18} Dexterity saving throw or take 13 ({@damage 3d8}) Cold damage.

Frost giants who master rune magic are known as ice shapers, and their sheer power typically contributes to a meteoric rise in the giants' ordning. Many of them end up as jarls, leading their communities, or as advisers to jarls—often the true power behind the throne. They are usually devoted to Thrym.

True to their name, these ice shapers manipulate the raw elemental energy of air and water to wield ice in both offense and defense. They summon ice elementals in the shape of wolves, cloak themselves in icy armor, and just as quickly turn that armor into a hail of deadly ice shards.

In ancient times, Hjoölvir, was well known in the Icewind Dale region, a frost giant of immense power, able to summon ice storms with a single thought. Her throne, hidden deep in the frozen expanses of Icewind Dale, was the heart of her dominion, where two wolves of elemental fury guarded her. Fearing her growing strength, humans devised a plan to imprison her. Using mirrors that distorted light and runes that dampened her magic, they lured Hjoölvir into a trap.

The dungeon holding Hjoölvir has remained intact due to the Twenty Stones of Thruun, a circle of standing stones located in Dougan's Hole. Though these stones have held her for over a thousand years, the barrier is slowly weakening, and Hjoölvir's fury intensifies. When she breaks free, winter will descend upon the land once again.

legendary.name: Greataxe Attack
entries: Hjoölvir makes a Greataxe attack. She can't take this action again until the start of her next turn.

legendary.name: Enhanced Rush
entries: Hjoölvir moves up to her Speed without provoking Opportunity Attacks.

legendary.name: Absorb Elemental (Requires Frost Rune)
entries: If an Ice Wolf is within 30 feet of Hjoölvir, she magically absorbs it, regaining Hit Points equal to half the wolf's remaining Hit Points (rounded up), and the wolf disappears.

trait.name: Cold Regeneration
entries: If the temperature around him is 0°F (-18°C) or lower, Sephek regains 15 Hit Points at the start of his turn. If he takes Fire damage, this trait doesn't function at the start of his next turn. Sephek dies only if he starts his turn with 0 Hit Points and doesn't regenerate.

trait.name: Frozen Predator
entries: Sephek has Advantage on attack rolls against any creature that hasn't taken a turn yet in combat.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: Sephek makes three attacks, using Ice Longsword or Ice Dagger in any combination.

action.name: Ice Longsword
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit +9}, reach 5 ft. {@h}12 ({@damage 1d8 + 8}) Slashing damage, or 13 ({@damage 1d10 + 8}) Slashing damage if wielded with two hands, plus 10 ({@damage 3d6}) Cold damage.

action.name: Ice Dagger
entries: {@atkr r} {@hit +9}, range 20/60 ft. {@h}9 ({@damage 1d4 + 7}) Piercing damage plus 10 ({@damage 3d6}) Cold damage. The target's Speed decreases by 10 feet until the end of Sephek's next turn.

action.name: Frostwind Slash {@recharge 5}
entries: Sephek swings his longsword in a freezing arc. {@actSave con} {@dc 17}, each creature in a 15-foot Cone. {@actSaveFail} 31 ({@damage 7d8}) Cold damage. {@actSaveSuccess} Half damage.

reaction.name: Frozen Riposte
entries: {@actTrigger} A creature within 5 feet of Sephek misses him with a melee attack. {@actResponse} Sephek makes one Ice Longsword attack against that creature.

spellcasting.name: Innate Spellcasting
headerEntries: Sephek's spellcasting ability is Charisma (spell save DC 17, +9 to hit with spell attacks). He can innately cast the following spells, requiring no spell components:

3e: {@spell armor of agathys|xphb} (at 5th level, 25 Temporary Hit Points, 25 Cold damage)

trait.name: Aura of Winter
entries: Allies within 10 feet of Eva have resistance to Fire damage. Enemies that start their turn within 10 feet of her must succeed on a DC 15 Constitution saving throw or have their Speed decrease by 10 feet until the start of their next turn.

action.name: Mace
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit +3}, reach 5 ft. {@h}4 ({@damage 1d6 + 1}) Bludgeoning damage.

action.name: Channel Divinity (1/Short Rest)
entries: Eva can use her Channel Divinity to either take the Turn Undead action or invoke a chilling blessing, causing up to three creatures of her choice within 30 feet to regain 15 Hit Points.

spellcasting.name: Spellcasting
headerEntries: Eva's spellcasting ability is Wisdom (spell save DC 15, +7 to hit with spell attacks). She has the following cleric spells prepared:

trait.name: Frost-Forged Training
entries: Adan's melee weapon attacks deal an extra 7 ({@damage 2d6}) Cold damage.

trait.name: Icebound Agility
entries: Adan can take the Dash or Disengage action as a Bonus Action on each of his turns.

trait.name: Winter's Tenacity
entries: Once per day, when Adan would be reduced to 0 Hit Points, he can instead drop to 1 Hit Point.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: Adan makes three Frost Blades attacks.

action.name: Frost Blades
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit +7}, reach 5 ft. {@h}9 ({@damage 1d8 + 5}) Slashing damage plus 7 ({@damage 2d6}) Cold damage.

action.name: Glacial Dash {@recharge 5}
entries: Adan moves up to his Speed without provoking Opportunity Attacks. At any point during this movement, he can make one Frost Blades attack against up to three different creatures (one attack per creature).

trait.name: Immovable Object
entries: At the start of each of Charon's turns, if he has any Unstoppable Force charges (see below), he gains 10 Temporary Hit Points, and that number then decreases by 1.

trait.name: Unstoppable Force
entries: Charon has a number of Unstoppable Force charges (maximum 4, see Immovable Object above for how they are also spent) that increases by 1, to that maximum, each time he takes damage. Immediately after being hit by a melee attack, Charon makes an Unarmed Strike attack against the attacker; this doesn't require his reaction. Each time Charon attacks this way, the attack has an additional effect based on his current number of charges:

items.name: 1 charge.
items.entry: The target must succeed on a {@dc 18} Strength saving throw or be pushed up to 15 feet straight away from Charon.

items.name: 2 charges.
items.entry: The target must succeed on a {@dc 18} Dexterity saving throw or have the {@condition Prone} condition.

items.name: 3 charges.
items.entry: The target must succeed on a {@dc 18} Constitution saving throw or have the {@condition Stunned} condition until the end of Charon's next turn.

items.name: 4 charges.
items.entry: This attack has reach 10 feet instead of 5 feet. The target must make a {@dc 18} Constitution saving throw. {@actSaveFail} The target is reduced to 0 Hit Points. {@actSaveSuccess} The target takes 55 ({@damage 10d10}) Fire damage. Regardless of the result, Charon's charges reset to 0, and the next attack that hits him before the start of his next turn is an automatic Critical Hit.

trait.name: Legendary Resistance (1/Day)
entries: If Charon fails a saving throw, he can choose to succeed instead.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: Charon makes three Unarmed Strike attacks.

action.name: Unarmed Strike
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit +12}, reach 5 ft. {@h}12 ({@damage 1d10 + 7}) Bludgeoning damage.

action.name: Wholeness of Body (1/Day)
entries: Charon regains 60 Hit Points.

reaction.name: Aura of the Guardian
entries: {@actTrigger} An attack roll hits {@creature Haumea, the 2nd Pillar|IcewindDaleRimeoftheLamberto|Haumea} while Charon is within 30 feet of Haumea or of the attacker. {@actResponse} Charon teleports to a space within 5 feet of Haumea or of the attacker (whichever applies), and the triggering attack hits him instead of Haumea.

legendary.name: True Protector
entries: Charon restores his reaction.

legendary.name: Enhanced Rush
entries: Charon moves up to his Speed without provoking Opportunity Attacks.

trait.name: Lightning Blood
entries: A creature within 5 feet of Haumea takes 5 ({@damage 1d10}) Lightning damage whenever it hits her with a melee attack that deals Piercing or Slashing damage.

trait.name: Legendary Resistance (2/Day)
entries: If Haumea fails a saving throw, she can choose to succeed instead.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: Haumea makes two attacks, using Arc Lightning or Thunderbolt in any combination.

action.name: Arc Lightning
entries: {@atkr m,r} {@hit +11}, reach 10 ft. or range 30 ft. {@h}18 ({@damage 4d8}) Lightning damage. If the target is a creature, it can't take reactions until the start of its next turn, and lightning jumps from the target to another creature of Haumea's choice that she can see within 30 feet of the target. The second creature must succeed on a {@dc 19} Dexterity saving throw or take 18 ({@damage 4d8}) Lightning damage.

action.name: Thunderbolt {@recharge 5}
entries: {@atkr r} {@hit +11}, range 500 ft. {@h}20 ({@damage 2d12 + 7}) Lightning damage, and the target has the {@condition Blinded} and {@condition Deafened} conditions until the start of Haumea's next turn.

bonus.name: Teleport
entries: Haumea teleports, along with any equipment she is wearing or carrying, up to 30 feet to an unoccupied space that she can see.

legendary.name: Arc Lightning
entries: Haumea makes one Arc Lightning attack.

legendary.name: Protect Me!
entries: Haumea teleports {@creature Charon, the Protector|IcewindDaleRimeoftheLamberto|Charon} to an unoccupied space she can see within 10 feet of herself, provided that Charon is on the same plane of existence as her. Haumea can't take this action again until the start of her next turn.

spellcasting.name: Spellcasting
headerEntries: Haumea casts one of the following spells, requiring no Material components and using Wisdom as the spellcasting ability (spell save {@dc 17}):

trait.name: Legendary Resistance (1/Day)
entries: If the sunmaster fails a saving throw, she can choose to succeed instead.

trait.name: Action Surge (1/Day)
entries: On her turn, the sunmaster can take one additional action.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The sunmaster makes three Lightbringer attacks.

action.name: Lightbringer
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit +9}, reach 5 ft. {@h}8 ({@damage 1d6 + 5}) Bludgeoning damage. If the target is an Undead creature and Lightbringer is glowing, the sunmaster deals an extra 3 ({@damage 1d6}) Radiant damage.

action.name: Channel Divinity: Radiance of the Dawn (1/Day)
entries: Any magical darkness in a 30-foot Emanation originating from the sunmaster is dispelled. {@actSave con} {@dc 17}, each enemy in the emanation. {@actSaveFail} 44 ({@damage 8d10}) Radiant damage. {@actSaveSuccess} Half damage. A creature that has Total Cover from the sunmaster is unaffected.

bonus.name: Sun Strike
entries: Immediately after the sunmaster hits a creature with a weapon attack, she can trigger this Bonus Action. The target takes an extra 9 ({@damage 2d8}) Radiant damage and ignites with radiant light. At the start of each of its turns, the ignited target takes 4 ({@damage 1d8}) Radiant damage and then makes a Constitution saving throw against {@dc 17}, ending the ignition on itself on a success. The ignition also ends after 1 minute.

reaction.name: Warding Flare (3/Day)
entries: {@actTrigger} A creature within 30 feet of the sunmaster is attacked by a creature she can see. {@actResponse} The sunmaster imposes Disadvantage on the attack roll.

legendary.name: Lightbringer
entries: The sunmaster makes one Lightbringer attack.

legendary.name: Move
entries: The sunmaster moves up to her Speed without provoking Opportunity Attacks.

spellcasting.name: Spellcasting
headerEntries: The sunmaster casts one of the following spells, requiring no Material components, using Wisdom as the spellcasting ability (spell save {@dc 17}):

entries: Sunmasters were members of the Brotherhood of the Glorious Sun, a sect within the church of Lathander that believed that the Morninglord was a reincarnation of Amaunator and destined to transform into the Yellow God at some point in history.

Anaar is a human cleric from Marsember and sunmaster of Amaunator, she runs the Shrine of Amaunator located in Bryn Shander. When Anaar arrived to the city, she began organizing a torchbearing service, employing orphans, to light the ways of citizens moving about in the dark. Her torchbearers often brought her news of unlawful things occurring in the darkness, which she sought to deal with.

She calls Amaunator "the Morninglord," a name that southerners use to describe Lathander, a god of the dawn and rebirth. Anaar views Lathander as a usurper of Amaunator's light and doesn't like it when people confuse the two deities.

entries: If Yggdra fails a saving throw, she can choose to succeed instead.

trait.name: Rage (3/Day)
entries: At the start of her first turn in a fight, Yggdra enters a rage: she gains 24 ({@damage 4d8 + 6}) Temporary Hit Points, her Speed increases by 10 feet, and she has Resistance to Bludgeoning, Piercing, and Slashing damage until the fight ends. Then, at the start of each of her turns while raging, she can choose another creature within 15 feet of her; that creature gains 18 ({@damage 4d8}) Temporary Hit Points.

trait.name: Relentless Rage (3/Day)
entries: If Yggdra drops to 0 Hit Points while raging and isn't killed outright, she can make a {@dc 12} Constitution Saving Throw. On a success, her Hit Points instead become 24 ({@damage 4d8 + 6}).

action.name: Multiattack
entries: Yggdra makes three Ebonrose attacks.

action.name: Ebonrose
entries: While raging, Yggdra can gain Advantage on this attack roll, but attack rolls against her have Advantage until the start of her next turn. {@atkr m} {@hit +10}, reach 10 ft. {@h}17 ({@damage 2d10 + 6}) Slashing damage. If the attack misses, Yggdra can deal 5 Slashing damage to the target instead. Once per turn, Yggdra can forgo that Advantage to deal an extra 5 ({@damage 1d10}) Slashing damage and reduce the target's Speed by 15 feet until the end of its next turn.

action.name: Wither and Bloom (3/Day)
entries: {@actSave con} {@dc 17}, each creature Yggdra chooses in a 10-foot-radius Sphere centered on a point within 60 feet. {@actSaveFail} 21 ({@damage 6d6}) Necrotic damage. {@actSaveSuccess} Half damage. Nonmagical plants in the Sphere wither. One creature in the Sphere can spend and roll up to five of its unspent Hit Dice, regaining a number of Hit Points equal to the roll plus Yggdra's Constitution modifier.

reaction.name: Branches of the Tree
entries: {@actTrigger} A creature Yggdra can see starts its turn within 30 feet of her while she is raging. {@actResponse d} {@actSave str} {@dc 18}, the triggering creature. {@actSaveFail} Spectral branches of the World Tree teleport the target to an unoccupied space Yggdra can see within 5 feet of her, or to the nearest unoccupied space she can see, and Yggdra can reduce its Speed to 0 until the end of the current turn.

legendary.name: Attack
entries: Yggdra makes one Ebonrose attack.

legendary.name: Move
entries: Yggdra moves up to her Speed without provoking Opportunity Attacks.

A half-elf barbarian of the Path of the World Tree, Yggdra was raised by a nomadic tribe attuned to nature's fury. Her bond with Yggdrasil lets her channel life-giving energy and warp space to protect others. She rose to prominence during a magical blizzard that unleashed awakened ice beasts on Easthaven. Yggdra quelled the storm, saving the town and earning her role as Captain.

Her rigid, stoic demeanor stems from tragedy: her husband Neb, a woodcarver, and their newborn perished in an avalanche unleashed by marauding yetis. This tragedy fuels her tactical brilliance and quiet empathy, driving her to shield Easthaven from harm.
Yggdrasil's roots endure blizzards and bloodshed.
So shall I.

item.name: Ebonrose
item.reqAttune: by a follower of the Path of the World Tree

entries.name: Wither and Bloom (3/Day)
entries: Ebonrose lets its bearer channel the World Tree's power. You can use an action to cast {@spell wither and bloom|scc} from Ebonrose as a 6th-level spell (spell save DC 17), requiring no material components. You can use this property a total of three times, and Ebonrose regains all expended uses at dawn.

Ebonrose is a glaive whose haft is a living branch grafted from Yggdrasil itself, its head unfurling in thorned black petals like a rose in eternal bloom. It was given to Yggdra Arlaggath by the World Tree in recognition of her unbroken vigil over Easthaven.

The weapon answers fully only to a bearer whose fury is tempered by devotion to something greater than themselves; in less devoted hands it still functions as a fine magic glaive, but none of the tales told of it are theirs to claim.
